scope: History method microbenchmark on Linux, not touch-to-audio, MainActor, Session.sync or physical device timing.

source.warning: This is the measured intermediate source snapshot, not a claimed final build/commit; later chord-rebuild and notation changes are separate.

method.fullValidationMix: Fresh Project value and History for each sample; History.apply, track 0 gain -= 0.01. Matches the earlier architecture mix workload.
method.firstUncertifiedMix: Fresh Project value and History for each sample; History.applyMix must fully validate the initial baseline.
method.certifiedContinuousMix: One real validated History reused; 0.01 dB gain changes coalesce; full-value certificate and mix-only equality/range validation run.
method.postUndoFirstMix: Setup and Undo excluded by inner timing; Undo clears certificate, so the measured applyMix validates fully again.
method.percentiles: Upper-middle median, nearest-rank p95; all raw durations retained.

limits: No physical iPhone, audio route, 30-minute load, thermal or memory measurement.
No SwiftUI, Session.sync, snapshot publication, compiler or audio callback latency in the measured History interval.
First unchecked edit and first edit after Undo remain expensive; the continuous result does not remove those costs.
Host scheduler/load and different source snapshots limit comparison to earlier absolute timings.
